question.question_text: After the camera wearer secures components with a screwdriver, _________ happens before they handle a circuit and a hard disk drive.

answer_options.text: Works with the thermal cooling assembly
Adjusts the position of the motherboard
Connects wires to the system board

shared_investigation.established_facts: The camera wearer uses a screwdriver to remove screws from the laptop motherboard, handles various components such as the hard drive, and places them on the table. The action of securing components with a screwdriver is followed by the handling of a circuit and a hard disk drive.

evidence_index.source_content: Disassembly of laptop: holding motherboard, placing on table, using screwdriver to remove screws, handling various components (memory card, cables, hard drive), picking up and repositioning the laptop.
Continued laptop disassembly and component removal: removing hard drive, cooling fan, screws using screwdriver, handling motherboard and back cover, placing components on table.
